manual.description: Pair Windows to Android with fresh identities, expired codes, duplicate submissions and reconnects; no duplicate contact or stuck invitation is allowed.
Pair Android to Windows with fresh identities, expired codes, duplicate submissions and reconnects; no duplicate contact or stuck invitation is allowed.
Queue messages while the recipient is offline, interrupt both clients around persistence and acknowledgement boundaries, and verify no loss or duplicate UI records.
Remove a relationship with both history policies, verify symmetric blocking, then pair again with fresh MLS state.
Verify deduplication, current-conversation suppression, cold-start routing and alert clearing.
Upgrade a real previous-beta profile and verify identity, contacts, history, durable queues, attachment cache and preferences.
Exercise tray/background lifecycle, process termination, Tor loss and network changes without fatal UI state, unbounded memory growth or data loss.
Verify size limits, encrypted cache, cancellation, retry, clearing and explicit gallery export.
Export diagnostics after real messaging and independently verify that plaintext, attachments, keys, pairing codes and capability tokens are absent.
Exercise Doze, battery saver, restricted background, reboot, process kill and network transitions.
Verify tray lifecycle, explicit exit, autostart, sleep/hibernate, second launch and restart after upgrade.
